name: DepFailBench
description: DepFailBench is a deterministic fault-injection benchmark for studying dependency-failure behavior in generated backend services. Version 1.1.0 contains the hardened evaluator, three repeat-stable evaluations of 320 saved programs, the 53-program correction ledger, a reusable task-adapter interface, post-hoc strategy taxonomy, and 54 formal records from externally sourced Stripe and Seam SDK contracts. The generated source was not repaired. Software files are licensed under MIT; study data are licensed under CC BY 4.0.
